title: Beat the Heat: Clarksville Heat Management Plan - Clarksville, United States of America
landscapes: Athletics, Healthcare, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Rural
description: Clarksville’s first Heat Management Plan is being established at a crucial time for the town and the nation. Extreme summer heat has always posed a threat to human health, especially to our most vulnerable individuals and community; however, recent and projected rising summer temperatures place an even greater urgency on developing solutions to this issue. At the same time, the Town is broadening its vision for Clarksville’s future.
